dedupe_keys.name: eba reporting frameworks data point model xbrl taxonomies and validation rules

description: The EBA reporting frameworks set out what EU banks and investment firms must report to supervisors, and for each framework version the EBA publishes a consolidated version of the requirements with the unofficial consolidated regulatory text, reporting templates and instructions, the Data Point Model (DPM) that defines the data items, and XBRL taxonomies that express the DPM's business concepts, relations and validation rules in XBRL format. Validation rules change through an updated package about two months before the first reference date of a release and small packages every quarter, and a single Excel file holds the latest rules for all releases. It is produced by the European Banking Authority. Coverage is the European Union's supervisory reporting, such as the COREP and FINREP returns used in the transparency exercise. The materials are available free to download; the page read gives no reuse licence. Caveats: these are reporting specifications, not bank data, and frequent releases mean tools must track versions. For simulation it explains the structure of the supervisory data behind EU bank-level datasets, so that financial resilience models can map balance sheet and exposure fields correctly. It is related to the EBA EU-wide transparency exercise and XBRL standard records in this catalogue.
